chunks.text: ORDER SHEET I٨ HIGH COURT OF SINDH BENCH AT SUKKUR N0.0-1329 0f 2023 Date Order with signature Of Judge For hearing of main case 14.11.2023 Mr Abdul Basit Shaikh Advocate for Respondents No 4 to 6 Mr Saeed Ahmed Wassan, AAG Hn4h4rr+nr+ ٠ ٤ ٠ 1 None present for the Petitioner however, learned Counsel for the Respondents No 4 to 6 submits that there is outstancing amount 0f R5.141000/- which will be paid to the petitioner in two equal monthly installments view of such statement this petition has served its purpose and accordingly disposed of However, default of said amount to the petitioner would Expose non payment violator to the contempt proceedings TH٤
